headline: Tesla Powerwall 3: Integrated Inverter and High Output
summary: Homeowners comparing quotes will find the Powerwall 3 fundamentally different from AC-coupled batteries. It features a built-in solar inverter, simplifying many new installs and changing how quotes should itemize hardware.

product_lines.name: Powerwall 3
product_lines.notes: ~13.5 kWh usable class; high continuous output designed for heavy loads. Confirm latest Tesla datasheet for your configuration.

questions_to_ask_installer: Is my electrical panel compatible without a main panel upgrade?
Are you a Tesla Certified Installer for warranty activation?
red_flags: Quoted Powerwall 3 alongside a separate SolarEdge/Enphase solar inverter on a new DC-coupled design without a clear retrofit reason.

sections.heading: Why Powerwall 3 changes solar quotes in 2026
sections.body: The Powerwall 3 integrates solar inverter capability so many new systems wire panels into the battery unit rather than a separate string inverter. That can simplify installs — and it can also create waste if a quote double-counts inverter hardware. For retrofits with existing inverters, AC-coupled batteries may still fit better.

faqs.question: Can I run my air conditioner during an outage with a Powerwall 3?
faqs.answer: Many homes can with sufficient continuous and surge capacity — verify your HVAC starting current against Tesla’s latest published specs and your installer’s load calculation.
